channel.title: Stash for Mac
channel.description: Updates for Stash for Mac. Written by scripts/release-mac.sh; installed copies read it.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
Security and reliability fixes.
- Fixed a crash when the app received a malformed request from the extension bridge - Only posts that link to X are accepted from the extension, and only X links are opened - A library saved by a newer version of Stash now opens read-only instead of being set aside - Saves from the extension can no longer get lost when two happen at once - No more repeated alerts when a save from the extension fails - Gallery posts can now be read and opened with VoiceOver

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description: Updates now come from the main Stash repo. Nothing else changed.
